beats.narration: एउटा सुईले औषधि बेकार बनाउन सक्छ!
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a giant glowing syringe looming over a tiny sad buffalo on white background, ink style, dramatic red accent
beats.motionPrompt: Fast zoom-in on the syringe as the buffalo shrinks back

beats.visual: The syringe cracks and shatters into tiny pieces, a large question mark appears above the buffalo, ink style
Wide shot of a simple Nepali cattle shed with a thatched roof, the farmer standing at the entrance, flat ink style
Farmer sitting beside the lying buffalo, hand on his forehead, worried face, sweat drops, flat ink style
Close-up of the buffalo’s swollen red udder with small pain marks around it, flat ink style
Neighbor walking into the shed through the doorway, waving one hand, flat ink style
beats.motionPrompt: Gentle pan following the neighbor as he walks in toward the farmer

beats.visual: Farmer pointing at the buffalo’s udder while looking up at the neighbor, speech bubble with a question mark, flat ink style
Farmer with open palms raised, shrugging, big question marks floating around his head, flat ink style
Neighbor waving his hand dismissively with a relaxed smile, a small ‘normal’ checkmark bubble, flat ink style
Neighbor pointing toward a distant village pharmacy shop, a medicine strip floating beside him, flat ink style
Neighbor miming an injection with a thumbs-up, a syringe icon and a big green tick bubble above him, flat ink style

beats.visual: Farmer with palms pressed together in namaste, smiling with relief, flat ink style

beats.narration: कुन औषधिले काम गर्छ, थाहा हुँदैन।

Doctor pointing to a microscope icon with a lab flask beside it, flat ink style

Doctor and farmer walking together toward a small clinic building, flat ink style
Doctor in the clinic carefully collecting a milk sample from the buffalo into a small sterile tube, flat ink style
Doctor looking into a microscope with a petri dish and test tubes on the table, flat ink style

beats.visual: Doctor holding a lab report with a highlighted green check beside one antibiotic name, flat ink style

beats.narration: ल हेर्नुस्, यो एन्टिबायोटिक उपयुक्त छ।

Calendar with a few days circled in red and a pill icon above them, doctor holding up fingers to count the days, flat ink style
Dark red germs growing larger with armor shields around them, a danger sign flashing, flat ink style
